consequence.statement: A new metric is added; nothing breaks or changes for existing configurations.

original.statement: Cilium 1.16 adds a new metric, cilium_identity_label_sources, counting identities per label source (e.g. separate fqdn and cidr label metrics); no operational consequence.

decision.reason: The upgrade notes list `cilium_identity_label_sources` under "Added Metrics" and describe it only as a new metric that counts identities per label source [ev-793c99a321e0]. The evidence says nothing fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or changes for existing configurations. So the consequence is "none", which makes it informational rather than review or action.
